about_the_game:
Play Cute. Think Smart. Score Big.

Welcome to Pokerii, a kawaii roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a tiny chess piece with big potential. Build your deck, place your cards, and rack up points by creating clever combos on a 3x3 board.

Collect pets, pick food, and power up your deck to survive an escalating series of waves filled with unique challenges and charming visuals.

About Pokerii

Inspired by chess and cozy roguelikes, Pokerii blends quick-thinking strategy with wholesome design. Your deck is small, your board is tight, and every decision matters. Whether you're stacking ranks to hit a combo or choosing a food that boosts your next wave, you'll find plenty of room for creative play.

Features

  • Chess-Inspired Deckbuilding
    Use a 16-card deck of themed pieces—like pawns, knights, and queens—and place them on a 3x3 grid to plan your moves and activate scoring effects.

  • Combo-Based Gameplay
    Score points by playing cards that match specific sum-based combos (like 15, 20, or 25). Learn the patterns and chase high-value turns with every wave.

  • Wave-Based Progression
    Face increasingly tricky challenges in a series of short, punchy waves. Each one pushes your planning, positioning, and scoring to the next level.

  • Pets & Food
    Between waves, visit a cozy café to adopt pets or choose food that grant permanent or temporary bonuses. Build a deck that fits your favorite playstyle.

  • Adorable Visuals
    A soft, chibi artstyle with vibrant icons, clean UI, and cozy animations makes Pokerii a joy to look at and a breeze to play.

Small Deck. Big Brain. Cozy Vibes.

Whether you’re chasing high scores or just enjoying the cute combos, Pokerii offers a charming, strategic twist on chess and deckbuilding—made for short runs, smart plays, and sweet rewards.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft® Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3240 (2 * 3400); AMD FX-4300 (4 * 3800)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 Ti (1024 VRAM); Radeon HD 7750 (1024 VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: The kawaii chess roguelike. Pokerii is a cozy deckbuilder where you play adorable chess-themed cards on a 3x3 board to trigger powerful combos and earn points. Collect pets and food to boost your deck and clear wave after wave of quirky challenges.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
